@@U03050@@
Yes, how could you have? The only ghosts you know are romantic. And yet, to be genuine, a ghost must be classical, too.

@@U03052@@
Yes, well, how do we get there? I’ve already had too much of antique colleagues.

@@U03054@@
Your favorite pleasure ground, Satan, as I understand, is the Northwest. This time we sail southeastward. To a great plain where the 珀涅俄斯河 flows freely through groves and thickets in cool and winding bends. And the plain stretches even to mountain gorges where the lowlands rise, and up above lies Pharsalos, the old and the new.

@@U03056@@
Spare me! I’ve had enough of your ancient history! Eternal battles between tyranny and slavery! They bore me. No sooner does the fighting end than it begins all over again. And neither side, neither, notices that it’s Asmodeus back of it all, teasing them. They fight, it’s said, for the rights of freedom; but more properly seen, it’s slaves fighting slaves.

@@U03058@@
Allow men their contrariety. Staying intact is no easy task. From boyhood on he has to defend himself; it's what makes him a man.
translation:
@@U03050@@
是啊，你怎么能有呢？你所知道的唯一的鬼魂是浪漫的。然而，要想真实，鬼魂也必须是古典的。

@@U03052@@
是的，那么我们怎样才能到达那里呢？我已经有太多古董同事了。

@@U03054@@
撒旦，你最喜欢的游乐场，据我所知，是西北。这次我们向东南航行。前往一片大平原，珀涅俄斯河在凉爽而蜿蜒的河道中自由地流过树林和灌木丛。平原甚至延伸到山谷，那里有低地升起，上面是法萨洛斯，无论是新的还是旧的。

@@U03056@@
饶了我吧！我已经受够了你们古老的历史！暴政与奴隶制之间的永恒之战！他们让我厌烦。战斗一结束，一切又重新开始。双方都没有注意到这是阿斯莫蒂斯在幕后黑手，在戏弄他们。据说，他们为自由权利而战。但更恰当地说，这是奴隶与奴隶之间的战斗。

@@U03058@@
允许男人有相反的一面。保持完好无损并不是一件容易的事。从孩提时代起，他就必须保护自己；这就是他成为男人的原因。
